findings.highlight: I walk through the night town.
findings.evidenceJa: 夜の住宅地を歩く。
findings.governingReading: Shirou walks through a residential district at night.
findings.explanation: “Night town” is unnatural and replaces the concrete residential setting with a vague town.

findings.highlight: It’s still seven o’clock
findings.evidenceJa: まだ七時前という事もあり
findings.governingReading: Because it is still before seven.
findings.explanation: The English changes a pre-seven interval into seven o’clock.

findings.highlight: I might throw up
findings.evidenceJa: 口から胃液でも吐き出しそうだ。
findings.governingReading: He feels liable to vomit even stomach acid.
findings.explanation: The English removes the caustic bodily detail 胃液.

findings.highlight: The invisible guard is watching out for the one he has to protect.
findings.evidenceJa: その守るべき対象である俺を、何よりも警戒している。
findings.governingReading: The guard is more wary of Shirou, the very person he should protect, than anything else.
findings.explanation: “Watching out for” reverses hostile vigilance into protective concern.

findings.highlight: The hostility I feel
findings.evidenceJa: 神経をすり減らすほどの敵意
findings.governingReading: Hostility intense enough to grind Shirou’s nerves away.
findings.explanation: The English omits the stated physiological intensity.

findings.highlight: He appears, with hostility still present.
findings.evidenceJa: 敵意を放ったまま実体化した。
findings.governingReading: Archer materializes while continuing to emit hostility.
findings.explanation: Generic appearance loses the Servant mechanic 実体化 and weakens active emission into mere presence.

findings.highlight: It seems you can at least feel hostility.
findings.evidenceJa: 殺気を感じ取れる程度には心得があるらしい。
findings.governingReading: Archer grants that Shirou has enough training to sense killing intent.
findings.explanation: “Hostility” weakens lethal intent and omits 心得, the grudging recognition of training.

findings.highlight: I confront the knight in red.
findings.evidenceJa: 気圧されないように、全身で赤い騎士と対峙する。
findings.governingReading: Shirou confronts Archer with his whole body so as not to be overawed.
findings.explanation: The English removes both embodied effort and purpose.

findings.highlight: He smiles as if to make fun of me and shrugs his shoulders.
findings.evidenceJa: 人を小馬鹿にするように鼻で笑って、やれやれ、なんて、これ見よがしに肩をすくめた。
findings.governingReading: Archer snorts contemptuously and makes a conspicuous “good grief” shrug.
findings.explanation: The English turns the nasal scoff into a smile and omits the voiced and ostentatious mockery.

findings.highlight: is only a half-ass.
findings.evidenceJa: 半人前だ。
findings.governingReading: A bloodless magus is only half-trained or not fully fledged.
findings.explanation: “A half-ass” is malformed vulgar English and changes professional incompleteness into a generic insult.

findings.highlight: This path is a path wet with blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身が手を下さずとも、進む道は血に濡れるものなのだ
findings.governingReading: Even if a magus never acts with his own hands, the road he follows becomes blood-soaked.
findings.explanation: The English omits the central distinction between direct personal harm and complicity.

findings.highlight: She is rather kind-hearted
findings.evidenceJa: いささか甘すぎるきらいはあるが
findings.governingReading: Rin has a tendency to be somewhat too soft.
findings.explanation: The English turns Archer’s criticism of excessive softness into a positive trait.

findings.highlight: The same thing that happened in the woods today
findings.evidenceJa: 雑木林であった、一瞬の殺し合いと同じ事を
findings.governingReading: The same instantaneous fight to the death that occurred in the grove.
findings.explanation: The English deletes both the mortal character and split-second duration of the encounter.

findings.highlight: I wish today would be the only case.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日のような体たらくは今回かぎりにしてほしいものだ。
findings.governingReading: Archer hopes Rin’s disgraceful state or performance today will never recur.
findings.explanation: “Case” removes his contemptuous judgment 体たらく and leaves the referent vague.

findings.highlight: turns immature
findings.evidenceJa: 年相応に戻ってしまう
findings.governingReading: When facing Shirou, Rin regrettably returns to behaving her actual age.
findings.explanation: “Immature” adds a negative developmental judgment instead of Archer’s ironic age-appropriateness.

findings.highlight: she’s still doing meaningless things.
findings.evidenceJa: 余分な事をしている。
findings.governingReading: Rin is doing something extra or unnecessary despite not needing Shirou.
findings.explanation: “Meaningless” denies purpose or value and is stronger than 余分.

findings.highlight: I wanted to complain to him.
findings.evidenceJa: 一言文句を言わなくちゃ気が済まなかっただけだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou could not be satisfied until he had voiced one complaint.
findings.explanation: “Wanted” removes the inner compulsion and 一言’s bounded purpose.

findings.highlight: How stupid of you.
findings.evidenceJa: 幸せな男だ。
findings.governingReading: Archer sarcastically calls Shirou a fortunate or blissfully ignorant man.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the irony with a direct accusation of stupidity.

findings.highlight: we become support for people in the future.
findings.evidenceJa: 以後は人々の間で語り継がれ、その支えになるもの
findings.governingReading: Thereafter Heroic Spirits are passed down in people’s telling and become their support.
findings.explanation: The English deletes cultural transmission through continued narration.

findings.highlight: We are beings that should not exist.
findings.evidenceJa: 在るが無い物。
findings.governingReading: They are things that exist and yet are absent or nonexistent.
findings.explanation: The English replaces an ontological paradox with a normative claim that they ought not exist.

findings.highlight: Our wills are taken away.
findings.evidenceJa: 永遠に人間の為に働き続ける掃除屋にすぎん
findings.governingReading: Once trapped in that state, a Guardian is merely a cleaner forced to work for humanity forever.
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits the entire eternal labor and “cleaner” image, ending after loss of will.

findings.highlight: what should only be a part of the main body
findings.evidenceJa: 本体からの触覚でしかない英霊
findings.governingReading: A Heroic Spirit is normally only a feeler or sensory extension projected from the main body.
findings.explanation: Generic “part” removes the technical-organic 触覚 metaphor.

findings.highlight: we are summoned as the real heroic spirits.
findings.evidenceJa: 本体そのものとして使役する
findings.governingReading: The ritual gives that extension form and employs it as the main body itself.
findings.explanation: The English removes使役, servile employment, and substitutes a claim about being the “real” Heroic Spirit.

findings.highlight: As heroic spirits are given bodies
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントという殻を与えられた英霊
findings.governingReading: A Heroic Spirit given the shell called a Servant.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the specific Servant shell with generic bodies, blurring the system’s levels.

findings.highlight: Along with our former desires and grudges.
findings.evidenceJa: かつての執念、かつての無念と共にな
findings.governingReading: They regain former obsession and unresolved regret along with humanity.
findings.explanation: “Desires and grudges” changes both psychological terms and makes 無念 interpersonal resentment.

findings.highlight: fulfill our desires
findings.evidenceJa: 叶わなかった無念を晴らせる
findings.governingReading: They can clear or redress the unresolved regret that went unfulfilled.
findings.explanation: The English changes 無念 into desires and omits 晴らす’s release or redress.

findings.highlight: If it allows them to grant the wishes they had before they died
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らが生前に叶わなかった願いさえ果たせるというのなら
findings.governingReading: If the Grail can fulfill even the wishes they failed to achieve in life.
findings.explanation: The English makes the Servants grant wishes rather than have their own wishes fulfilled.

findings.highlight: nor do I wish to stay here as a human.
findings.evidenceJa: 人としてここに留まる事にも興味はない
findings.governingReading: Archer has no interest in remaining here as a human.
findings.explanation: The English changes lack of interest into absence of a wish, collapsing two distinct motivational claims.

findings.highlight: Archer murmurs.
findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と呟くアーチャー。
findings.governingReading: Archer murmurs in a stunned or vacant daze.
findings.explanation: The English omits the striking 呆然 reaction to “purpose.”

findings.highlight: Ask your Servant if you’re curious.
findings.evidenceJa: 問いただしてみるがいい。
findings.governingReading: If concerned, Shirou should press Saber and demand the truth.
findings.explanation: Generic asking weakens 問いただす’s probing insistence.

findings.highlight: an ideal guardian.
findings.evidenceJa: 典型的な守護者
findings.governingReading: Archer calls Saber a typical or archetypal Guardian in the sense he has just defined.
findings.explanation: “Ideal” turns classification into normative praise and clashes with his immediate “slave” condemnation.

findings.highlight: His presence disappears.
findings.evidenceJa: 薄れていく気配。
findings.governingReading: Archer’s presence gradually fades.
findings.explanation: The English changes an ongoing fading process into completed disappearance.

findings.highlight: talks cynically until the very end and leaves.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで憎まれ口を叩いて去っていった。
findings.governingReading: Archer departs still making spiteful or deliberately barbed remarks to the end.
findings.explanation: “Talks cynically” weakens interpersonal provocation into a general worldview.
